odc_type: Incorrect Namespace Handling in XPath Generation
observation_summary: The asPath() method returns an incorrect XPath string (e.g., using 'node()[2]' instead of 'test[1]') for elements that have an empty namespace declaration.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the asPath() method in the DOM node pointer implementation fails to correctly identify nodes that have an empty namespace URI (xmlns=""). When a node explicitly resets its namespace to an empty string, the current logic treats it as having a namespace, leading to incorrect path generation (e.g., using 'node()' instead of the element name) or infinite loops during prefix resolution. The evidence from the bug report and the failing test confirms that the logic needs to treat an empty namespace URI the same as a null namespace URI to correctly generate the XPath string.
